title: cmd_compare uses template-less mktemp with no cleanup trap; leaked files are unattributable and the repo's own T61 AC11 tripwire regex (mktemp -d\)) cannot match the non-directory form

Five timing modes leak their mktemp -d scratch tree on any failure or interrupt -- tail-position rm -rf with no trap under set -euo pipefail, while harness_scratch_dir (already sourced) exists for exactly this
--provision-only deliberately retains its scratch git repo under TMPDIR so the caller can inspect the printed path; no automated caller, never in a worktree
docs/audit-patterns/<type>.lock persists forever in the tracked plugin tree by CA-169 design; covered twice by root .gitignore lines 15 and 35, git status stays clean

update-patterns writes into the plugin's own install directory, but the read-only-install hazard is already guarded by the [[ -w $pattern_dir ]] skip at 5056; residue is a docs-consistency question for another lens
flock-timeout marker directory under TMPDIR can survive a signal in the microsecond window before its removal; empty, ephemeral-mount, and pre-removed at the same path on the next run with that PID

Justification comments still describe the G49 flock-timeout marker as an in-tree ${lockfile}.timeout.$$ path; G17/CA-305 moved it under TMPDIR, so the reason is stale though the widened globs remain correct and wanted

Two bare template-less mktemp -d calls (287, 558) plus one untrapped LIST_FILE (509) sit outside the T61 AC11 tripwire's scan set, but all are container-ephemeral with traps or trivial scope -- no accumulation

Per-initiative .gitignore block cross-checked against every runtime file EDM creates in an initiative directory (bak, tmp, lock, lockd, lockd.stale, all write_atomic staging paths incl. nested code-audit/) -- no uncovered file found

evals/runs/ retention verified sound: prune_old_runs fires from cleanup() on every exit path incl. interrupt, keeps 10, filters to run-shaped names; directory is *-gitignored and CI caps artifacts at 30 days
Deliberate mutation of the tracked docs/canonical-sections.md is fully covered by cleanup_wave6 on EXIT INT TERM HUP (CA-216) installed before any write -- verified, no gap
No hook, monitor, skill or agent creates a file of its own -- all nine command hooks delegate to edm-state/edm-lint-artifacts, and watch-impl is a read-only git log poll
CA-372 re-verified fixed: documented invocation now uses --out "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/edm-scores.json" with the CA-151 tracked-fixture rationale
CA-399 re-verified fixed: audit-converged stderr temp file now covered by _save_traps plus EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP traps calling _write_atomic_cleanup, then _restore_traps
CA-400 re-verified fixed: session_dir_for_test_cwd hard-refuses (exit 1) unless $HOME is under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}, before interpolating it
